Button strength determines trajectory (LK short, MK mid, HK far); cannot be steered manually after activation; follow-ups can be input starting on frame 24, and as late as frame 45 (236LK) / frame 42 (236MK) / frame 43 (236HK); can input OD follow-up with PP or KK for 2 Drive bars (safer on block); empty HK flip can have 1f longer or shorter aerial animation when crossing over the opponent at certain ranges; Yasmine is in a standing state with a standing-sized hurtbox during landing recovery

Enhances the properties of follow-up attacks (improved hit and block advantage, can be input with no extra meter cost); can be steered by holding back/neutral/forward before the follow-up starts (no input gives the same trajectory as 236LK); gives more freedom to control Yasmine's trajectory compared to the meterless flip; follow-ups can be input on frames 24-46; Yasmine is in a standing state with a standing-sized hurtbox during landing recovery

Button strength determines downward trajectory (LK short, MK mid, HK far); cannot hit cross-up; stalls mid-air to bait anti-airs; safe on block and links into light normals in almost all cases (worst advantage is only possible by inputting the follow-up right before landing against a point blank opponent); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state

2-hit boomerang projectile (can only hit once on the way up, then applies all remaining hits on the way back); button strength determines projectile distance (LP short / MP mid / HP far); the listed active frames are for the L/M/H versions respectively; projectile disappears if Yasmine is hit; can only have one boomerang on-screen at a time; only the first 3 active frames are Super cancelable; the initial upward hit keeps opponents grounded (less range vs. crouching opponents); the returning projectile puts opponents into a limited juggle state; canceling from 2HP gives increased hit advantage (use LP boomerang from point blank 2HP for a link into 2LP in the corner); projectile speed refers to the initial activation before changing directions

3-hit boomerang projectile (can only hit once on the way up, then applies all remaining hits on the way back); button combination determines projectile distance (LP+MP short / LP+HP mid / MP+HP far); the listed active frames are for the L/M/H versions respectively; projectile disappears if Yasmine is hit; can only have one boomerang on-screen at a time; only the first 3 active frames are Super cancelable; the initial upward hit keeps opponents grounded (less range vs. crouching opponents); the returning projectile puts opponents into a limited juggle state; canceling from 2HP gives increased hit advantage (use LP+MP boomerang from point blank 2HP for a link into 5LK); projectile speed refers to the initial activation before changing directions; the 2nd hit Juggle Limit depends on whether the 1st hit connected on the way up (if returning projectile has all 3 hits: JL 2,2,10; if only 2 hits on the returning projectile, JL 2 followed by JL 10,10); SA2 cancel: +16/+12

Puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit; active frames 1-3 transition into a fully invincible cinematic on hit (1st hit can trade for 500 damage); active frames 4-6 perform a non-cinematic hit (1600 damage, KD +18~20 vs. grounded opponents, variable vs. airborne); fast reversal and a strong anti-air even at close ranges; useful juggle ender in any scenario where 623HK can also land

Install that keeps Yasmine in Bayani Mode until the timer ends; timer lasts 1500 frames (25 seconds) and freezes during hitstop; cannot build additional Super gauge while the install is active; Yasmine stays in Bayani Mode after install ends (if 236P is activated with at least 1 frame left on the timer, the follow-up enhanced Alon can be used freely without spending the Bayani stock); grants access to a new special move Linya ng Liwanag (fast cross-up slash); changes the properties of OD Alon (new cinematic ender); each activation of an enhanced Bayani Mode special consumes 375f from the install timer (25%); install activation is useful for starting pressure from ranges approaches like 214PP or 236PP~6P (very high pushback and weak pressure when canceled directly from 5MP~MP or 236PP)

Requires SA2 install; each use consumes 375f (25%) of SA2 install timer; deals Drive Damage on normal hit (0.5 bars if both hits connect); reaches fullscreen and extends a huge proximity guard hitbox from frame 15 onward; if the 1st hit is blocked, parried, or absorbed by armor, Yasmine stops her forward movement and does not perform the 2nd hit (this hit has 2f active + 24f recovery); on hit, Yasmine will dash behind the opponent (even in the corner) and perform a 2nd hit that launches the opponent into a limited juggle state; this cross-up hit can also occur if the first hit whiffs (like in a knockdown setup or on a jumping opponent); cross-up hit has functionally 30f startup when used as an oki tool; can be canceled into from 2MK~HK and 5MK~MK~HK Target Combos on hit; active frame distribution is 2(11)5 when both hits connect; whiff recovery is 1f faster (19f) if Yasmine passes far behind the opponent before the 2nd hit comes out; startup time can be up to 3f faster (19f) if Yasmine passes through a close range airborne/teleporting opponent with no collision box; after a corner sideswitch, some follow-up juggles can whiff under the opponent (623HK requires delay, while 623MK and SA1 are auto-timed)
